21	  conversationId: string,
22	  onNew: (msg: ConversationMessage) => void,
23	): void {
24	  // Stable callback ref so useEffect doesn't re-run on every render
25	  const stableOnNew = useCallback((msg: Parameters<typeof onNew>[0]) => onNew(msg), [onNew])
26	
27	  useEffect(() => {
28	    if (!conversationId) return
29	
30	    const supabase = createClient()
31	
32	    const channel = supabase

41	        },
42	        (payload) => {
43	          stableOnNew(payload.new as ConversationMessage)
44	        },
45	      )
46	      .subscribe()
47	
48	    return () => {
49	      void supabase.removeChannel(channel)
50	    }

57	  price: number,
58	  tip: number,
59	  rule: CommissionPreviewRule | null | undefined,
60	  artistDefaultPct: number | null = null,
61	): CommissionPreviewResult {
62	  // If no rule supplied, fall back to artist default pct (mirrors trigger behaviour)
63	  const effectiveRule: CommissionPreviewRule =
64	    rule ?? (artistDefaultPct != null
65	      ? { percentage: artistDefaultPct, flat_fee_cents: null, tip_split_pct: 100 }
66	      : { percentage: null, flat_fee_cents: null, tip_split_pct: 100 })
67	
68	  let commission = 0
69	  const parts: string[] = []
70	
71	  if (effectiveRule.percentage != null && effectiveRule.flat_fee_cents != null) {
72	    commission =
73	      Math.round((price * effectiveRule.percentage) / 100) + effectiveRule.flat_fee_cents
74	    parts.push(`${effectiveRule.percentage}% + flat fee`)
75	  } else if (effectiveRule.percentage != null) {
76	    commission = Math.round((price * effectiveRule.percentage) / 100)
77	    parts.push(`${effectiveRule.percentage}%`)
78	  } else if (effectiveRule.flat_fee_cents != null) {

137	 * Participant split determines their share of booking revenue and tip.
138	 * Their individual commission rate comes from engagement (guest) or rule (regular).
139	 *
140	 * @param bookingPriceCents  Total booking service price in cents.
141	 * @param bookingTipCents    Total tip in cents.
142	 * @param participants       Array of participant inputs.
143	 */

145	  bookingPriceCents: number,
146	  bookingTipCents: number,
147	  participants: ParticipantCommissionInput[],
148	): ParticipantCommissionResult[] {
149	  return participants.map((p) => {
150	    const participantRevenueCents = Math.round(bookingPriceCents * (p.splitPct / 100))
151	    const participantTipCents = Math.round(bookingTipCents * (p.splitPct / 100))
152	
153	    let effectiveRule: CommissionPreviewRule
154	    let snapshot: ParticipantRuleSnapshot
155	
156	    if (p.guestEngagement != null) {
157	      // Guest engagement takes precedence
158	      effectiveRule = {
159	        percentage: p.guestEngagement.splitPctArtist,
160	        flat_fee_cents: p.guestEngagement.flatFeeCents,
161	        tip_split_pct: 100,
162	      }
163	      snapshot = {
164	        source: 'guest_engagement',
165	        engagement_id: p.guestEngagement.engagementId,
166	        split_pct_artist: p.guestEngagement.splitPctArtist,
167	        participant_split_pct: p.splitPct,
168	        booking_participant_role: p.role,
169	        percentage: p.guestEngagement.splitPctArtist,
170	        flat_fee_cents: p.guestEngagement.flatFeeCents,
171	        tip_split_pct: 100,
172	      }
173	    } else {
174	      // Regular commission rule resolution
175	      const rule = p.rule
176	      const fallbackPct = p.artistDefaultPct ?? null
177	      effectiveRule =
178	        rule ?? (fallbackPct != null
179	          ? { percentage: fallbackPct, flat_fee_cents: null, tip_split_pct: 100 }
180	          : { percentage: null, flat_fee_cents: null, tip_split_pct: 100 })
181	
182	      const source: ParticipantRuleSnapshot['source'] =
183	        rule != null ? 'service_specific' : fallbackPct != null ? 'artist_default' : 'none'
184	
185	      snapshot = {
186	        source,
187	        participant_split_pct: p.splitPct,
188	        booking_participant_role: p.role,
189	        percentage: effectiveRule.percentage,
190	        flat_fee_cents: effectiveRule.flat_fee_cents,
191	        tip_split_pct: effectiveRule.tip_split_pct,
192	      }
193	    }
194	
195	    const result = calculateCommission(
196	      participantRevenueCents,
197	      participantTipCents,
198	      effectiveRule,
199	    )
200

203	      artistId: p.artistId,
204	      role: p.role,
205	      splitPct: p.splitPct,
